nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=85 beats='Tomas and Abuela Rosa clear the workshop table the night before the Vela Verde spring festival; Abuela lays out three bundles for the kite frame and says the wind on Cerro Alto never blows the same way twice; Pimienta the cat bats a spool of waxed string across the tiles; Tomas has one night to build a kite that can fly in whatever wind shows up'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas bends a bamboo stick over his knee and it springs back perfectly straight; Abuela ties the cross spar with waxed string and tugs each corner to test it; the frame is light and springy but the joints creak when he lifts it'>>

choices.label: Cover it with the blue apron

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='the river reeds are so light Tomas can balance the whole frame on one finger; Abuela warns that reeds drink water and go soft as noodles; they prop the finished frame near the stove to dry while they work'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas splits the old broom handle into flat strips while Abuela guides the knife with her hand over his; the strips are strong and heavy and smell like cedar; Abuela says a heavy kite is not a bad kite, it is a kite that needs a big wind'>>

choices.label: Cover it with the blue apron

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='they glue bright papel picado over the frame, orange and pink, and Tomas snips a swallow shape into one corner; the paper crackles like a small fire every time it moves; Abuela names the kite Golondrina, little swallow'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Abuela cuts up her old blue apron, the one with the flour stain shaped like a duck, and Tomas stitches it to the frame with big crooked stitches; the cloth is soft and much heavier than paper; Abuela says nothing about the stain and Tomas notices'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='they paste three layers of old newspaper over the frame and the headlines run sideways across the kite; Tomas worries the paper will tear like wet bread; Abuela says paper is brave when it is dry and useless when it is not'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Tomas runs Golondrina around the courtyard while Pimienta chases the string; the kite lifts to the height of the lemon tree, wobbles hard from side to side, and skids down onto the tiles; Abuela watches the chimney smoke instead of the kite and says the wind here is only leftovers'>>

choices.label: Cut a vent in the sail

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='from the flat rooftop the wind arrives in warm pushes off the hills; Golondrina jumps up fast, spins twice like a dropped plate, and dives straight at the water tank; Abuela holds Tomas by the belt loop and laughs until she has to sit down'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas tears an old bedsheet into strips and knots a tail as long as he is tall, with a bow every hand width; Abuela says a tail is not decoration, it is a promise to the wind; Pimienta steals the very last strip and hides under the table with it'>>

choices.label: Fly her by the Rio Manso

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Abuela shows Tomas that the bridle knot decides where the kite looks; he slides the knot two fingers higher and the nose tips down when he holds the string up; they mark the new spot with a loop of red thread so they can find it again'>>

choices.label: Fly her by the Rio Manso

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas cuts a half moon vent near the top of the sail so a hard wind can spill through instead of shoving; the first cut comes out crooked and Abuela tells him to keep it; air whistles through the hole like a tiny flute'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='they peel the heavy sail off and stretch thin tissue paper over the frame instead, thin enough to see Tomas fingers through; the whole kite now weighs less than a bread roll; Abuela folds the leftover cloth away and says keep it, we may need it by morning'>>

choices.label: Fly her by the Rio Manso

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='on Cerro Alto the afternoon wind comes in shoves, quiet and then hard; Golondrina climbs above the goat path and the string starts to sing against Tomas thumb; then a gust hits from the side and folds her over, and Tomas has about one second to decide what his hands do'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='down by the Rio Manso the air lies completely still and the water looks like glass; Golondrina hangs off the end of the string like wet laundry and will not lift; a heron watches from the reeds without moving at all, which Tomas decides is rude'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='the plaza is already filling with festival stalls and Lucia and three cousins crowd in to watch; the wind bounces off the church wall and comes back in swirls that go every direction at once; Golondrina rises fast and straight toward the big jacaranda tree'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='the gust wins and the cross spar cracks with a sound like a bitten carrot; Golondrina comes down in the yellow grass with one wing bent backward; Tomas swallows hard and does not say anything, and Abuela sits down beside him on a warm rock and waits'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Golondrina finds a smooth layer of air and climbs until she is a bright speck over the whole valley; the string pulls steady and even, like a fish that has stopped fighting; Abuela says quietly, now remember exactly what you did, every single part of it'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='the string catches the jacaranda and Golondrina hangs up in the purple flowers three branches above Tomas head; Pimienta climbs halfway up the trunk and then refuses to go any further; petals keep drifting down onto Tomas face while he stares up at her'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='the wind stops completely, not a leaf and not a flag and not one strand of Tomas hair; Golondrina lies flat on the ground looking like a dropped umbrella; Abuela sits on the wall and says the wind is only taking a nap, and naps end'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='the tail drags through the reeds and rips a long tear straight across the sail; river mud smears the bright paper brown; Tomas pinches the two flaps together with his thumbs as if that could hold, and it cannot'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='a swirl off the church wall lifts Golondrina hard and she skims low over the candy stall and knocks a paper flag loose; Don Marco the festival caller catches the falling string with two fingers and hands it back to Tomas with one eyebrow up'>>

choices.label: Climb the jacaranda for clear air

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Abuela wraps the cracked bamboo spar in cloth strips and hot glue from the pot on the stove, then binds the whole splint with waxed string; Tomas holds it steady for eleven entire minutes without moving; the mended spar comes out a little fatter and a little stronger than before'>>

choices.label: Take her to the plaza workbench

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='they start over with a kite the size of a dinner plate, built from the scraps already on the table; small Golondrina takes barely an hour and needs almost no wind at all to lift; Pimienta sits squarely on the paper pattern the entire time'>>

choices.label: Fly her in the dawn field

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas carries Golondrina home tucked under his arm like a sleeping bird and props her beside his bed; he wakes on festival morning before the roosters do; Abuela is already up making atole and watching the flag on the church, which is barely moving'>>

choices.label: Go early to the quiet field
Go straight to the parade gate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas shows Lucia the red thread on the bridle and how to feel the pull with two fingers instead of grabbing with a fist; Lucia crashes twice and then holds Golondrina steady for a count of thirty; they trade turns until the sun goes orange behind Cerro Alto'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas climbs the jacaranda trunk while Abuela holds the ladder braced with her whole weight, up above the heads and the stalls and the swirling wall wind; purple petals stick to his sleeves; from up there he can finally see every festival flag in the plaza pointing the same direction'>>

choices.label: Come down and launch with Abuela

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Tomas runs the whole length of the plaza with the string over his shoulder, making his own wind out of nothing; Golondrina stays up for six steps, then eight, then simply stays; his lungs burn and he is grinning so wide his cheeks ache'>>

choices.label: Save your legs for the dawn field
Ask Lucia to hold the other end

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='at the kitchen table Tomas glues a patch cut from the old blue apron over the tear, so Golondrina now has one bright wing and one blue one with a duck shaped flour stain; Abuela says the patch is the part people will remember'>>

choices.label: Dry her on the plaza workbench
Show the blue wing to Lucia

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='festival morning on the dawn field and the air is dead still, every banner hanging like wet socks; forty kites lie waiting on the wet grass with forty owners standing over them; Don Marco announces the parade starts in one hour, wind or no wind, and Tomas has to choose how to spend that hour'>>

choices.label: Walk the parade holding her up
Show the little kids the bridle

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='at the parade gate the wind pours down off Cerro Alto in hard shoves that snap the banners straight out; two kites go up and one comes back down in pieces; Abuela puts her hand on Tomas shoulder and says you have already met this wind twice, you know what it does'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='the long workbench beside the church is crowded with kite makers trading glue and string and advice nobody asked for; Tomas has ten minutes and room for exactly one more repair; Abuela lays out her tools in a row and then steps back and lets him pick'>>

choices.label: Write down every fix so far

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='Tomas and Lucia stand thirty paces apart at the top of the field, one holding Golondrina and one holding the string spool; Abuela counts down from three in her big market voice; the whole village turns to watch the first kite of the parade go up'>>

choices.label: Launch with Lucia on the string
Launch on Abuelas count of three
Teach the cousins to launch too

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the string runs out to the very last knot and Golondrina climbs higher than the church bell tower, a bright orange speck over the whole green valley; the crowd tips their heads back all at once; Tomas feels the steady pull in both hands and does not let go, and Abuela does not say a word'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Golondrina and the yellow kite circle each other over the plaza for a full hour without tangling once; Don Marco ties the blue festival ribbon around both strings at the same time and writes two names on it; Abuela claps loud enough to be heard from the bell tower'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='no wind comes all day, so Tomas walks the entire parade route holding Golondrina up on two flat hands like a tray of sweet bread; small children follow behind him in a line to see the swallow shape; Abuela says a kite that got seen is not a kite that failed'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas kneels on the wet grass showing six small cousins where the bridle knot goes and why a tail is a promise to the wind; by noon there are seven wobbling kites in the sky and not one of them is his; Abuela watches from the shade and says absolutely nothing, which is how Tomas knows'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Abuela finally shows Tomas the bowline her own mother taught her, the knot that holds tight under pull and unties clean with one tug; the mended Golondrina flies better than she ever did new; Tomas practices the knot on the parade route until his fingers can do it without looking'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the biggest gust snaps the string with a pop like a broken guitar wire and Golondrina sails away over Cerro Alto, orange and blue and getting smaller; Tomas watches until he cannot find her against the clouds; Abuela says she is still flying somewhere out there, and that counts for something'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Tomas fills a whole notebook page with every fix they tried, the rag tail and the bridle knot and the vent and the blue patch, and what the wind did after each one; next spring he will not be starting from nothing; Abuela signs her name at the bottom of the page like a witness'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the glue is still tacky when Tomas launches and the patched sail peels open on the very first pull; Golondrina never gets above his shoulders and the parade goes past without her; Abuela sits with him on the church wall and says next year, we wait for the glue, and Tomas writes that down'>>
